items: Generative AI in Asia is already in production use, from game studios building environments and dialogue to labs simulating drug compounds.
Localized data, mobile-first consumers, government support and lean startups make the region fertile ground for generative AI.
Language diversity, evolving data laws and the cost of computing power remain real obstacles for companies building models in the region.
To prepare your business, audit workflows for generative AI readiness, train teams to work with AI tools, explore regional AI partners and track local regulation.
